summary: Well‑executed, preregistered paired study comparing a baseline single‑shot LLM generator to a guarded generate→validate→repair pipeline under shared_initial_candidate semantics. Execution and analysis artifacts are comprehensive and internally consistent. The preregistered primary test (exact two‑sided McNemar) did not reach α=0.05 (p=0.0625); the authors present this result honestly and discuss construct/external validity, the impact of very sparse discordant counts, and preregistration/design constraints. Key strengths: rigorous preregistration, deterministic accounting, preservation of mandatory master‑prompt provenance, appropriate exact paired test choice, and transparent archival of artifacts and validator traces. Primary concerns are editorial/bibliographic (citation/reference formatting and explicit claim–reference matching) and a short methodological clarification about the bootstrap summary given the extremely small number of discordant pairs.
critical_issues: References must be presented as a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography with full bibliographic metadata (authors, title, venue, year). The reviewer observed DOI/arXiv identifiers in the manuscript evidence bundle; if any Reference entry is currently a bare DOI/URL or identifier‑only record, it must be replaced by a full IEEE‑style reference (this is resolvable from the archived verified bibliography).

The manuscript presents a bootstrap percentile 95% CI as a secondary descriptive summary despite extremely sparse discordant counts (n10=5, n01=0). The Methods should briefly justify the bootstrap usage in this regime and clearly state its interpretive limits relative to the exact conditional McNemar test (the preregistered primary inferential result).
required_revisions: Replace any identifier‑only (bare DOI/arXiv/OpenAlex id) Reference entries with full IEEE‑style bibliographic metadata (authors, title, venue, year) and ensure the References section is a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography; update in‑text citation markers if necessary so all citations use IEEE numbering. (Can be resolved from the supplied verified bibliography/artifacts.)

In Methods (or a brief Statistics subsection) add one short paragraph explaining the bootstrap percentile CI computation and its limitations given very small discordant counts, explicitly noting why the exact McNemar two‑sided test remains the preregistered primary confirmatory test and how the bootstrap summary should be interpreted (descriptive sensitivity only). (Can be resolved using archived analysis_log.jsonl and bootstrap settings already recorded.)
optional_revisions: Add a brief table or sentence mapping each numbered in‑text citation to the specific claim it supports (especially for claims summarized in Related Work) to improve citation–claim traceability; use the archived verified bibliography for exact wording.

Expand the Limitations section with one or two sentences summarizing how the preregistered power assumption (target effect ~0.15) diverged from the observed baseline prevalence (0.995) and the practical consequences for detectable effect sizes—this improves interpretability but is optional because related text is already present.
